digest.component_or_area: plan-review gating (criterion T1), provider capability routing
propositions: Bedrock cutover broke T1's web-search grounding by prefix-matching on provider name: resolved.startswith('anthropic') returns False for 'bedrock:us.anthropic.claude-opus-4-8', so the web tool is not attached despite being declared in criteria_routing.json

T1 is a blocking criterion that now runs without its declared grounding tool, degrading evidence quality silently—codebase knowledge replaces current-source verification with no warning logged or provenance recorded
The prefix-match gate violates the epic's zero-exceptions rule requiring capability decisions from registry membership, not name shape

Web access must be guaranteed for T1 on every provider; if Bedrock's Converse API cannot carry the native tool, rebar must supply access via fallback (local search) while respecting egress/caching/injection bounds
provider_provenance.capabilities must record whether web access was attached so a silent withdrawal cannot recur
